text:
maya: Heads-up — Garnet customer private/VPC deploy is scheduled for Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC next week. Planning to run the full release with DB migrations, config push, and network cutover. Who can lead the slot?

sam: I can lead the deploy. I'll be primary in the runbook channel.

eli: I can do smoke and perf checks post-cutover. Will prepare the smoke checklist and a small load script.

jordan: I'll own rollback & DB rollback plan. Quick note: migration is additive but has a cleanup step; I want a 15m prewindow to run a dry-run against staging.

maya: @sam thanks. @jordan +1 on dry-run. Can you post the rollback steps here asap? Also tagging @ops-oncall for infra readiness.

jordan: Rollback steps (short):
1) Disable traffic to service using LB weights: `kubectl patch svc ...`
2) Restore DB from pre-migration snapshot: `pg_restore --clean --no-owner ...`
3) Re-deploy previous image tag: `redwoodctl deploy --image=redwood/api:release-2026-02-12`
4) Re-enable LB weights
I'll add exact commands to the runbook.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window created: Garnet-private-2026-03-24-02:00-04:00 UTC. Change ID: CHG-78922. Reminder 24h and 1h before window.

ops-oncall: LGTM for infra. Will reserve quiet slot on the hosts and keep a capacity buffer. Please confirm outage expectations for Garnet — will there be short read-only window?

maya: There will be a brief read-only for ~90s during migration. Not expecting longer downtime but we need to watch connection drains. Add a note in the runbook.

sam: Runbook items I'll cover:
- Prechecks (node health, free disk, KV cache sizes)
- Dry-run of DB migration on staging (jordan)
- Traffic ramp plan (weights: 0% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 10m)
- Smoke tests (eli)
- Rollback triggers: failed migration, >5% error rate, or latency >500ms p50 after 10m at 50% traffic

eli: Smoke checklist draft:
- auth login (3 users)
- key paths for API: `/v1/generate` and `/v1/embeddings` 5x each
- embedding consistency quick check (random sample)
- KV cache warmup verification
I'll drop a small k6 script in the runbook.

maya: Can everyone confirm they can join the channel during the window? Also please add your phone number in the runbook contact section.

jordan: Confirmed. I'll be available; ping me if DB snapshot fails.

sam: Confirmed. I'll post runbook link here once updated.

eli: Confirmed. Will upload smoke scripts by EOD Friday.

maya: Great. Action items:
- sam: update runbook + post link (due Fri EOD)
- jordan: dry-run & rollback commands in runbook (due Fri EOD)
- eli: smoke scripts and perf script (due Fri EOD)
- ops-oncall: reserve capacity and monitor infra (done)

maya: Thanks team — I'll follow up tomorrow with the final cadence and the pre-deploy checklist. :thumbsup:
